Create a modern, high-converting dark-theme landing page for an AI-powered SaaS product. Follow this precise layout structure, visual hierarchy, and component sequence:

1. DESIGN & COLOR PALETTE:
- Theme: Dark Mode (Background: #0B0F17 or #0D0D12; Card Backgrounds: #161B26 with subtle 1px border #2A324B).
- Primary Accent Color: High-contrast Accent (e.g., Electric Emerald #00E699 or Neon Cyan #00D8F6).
- Typography: Modern Sans-Serif (Inter or System UI) with Monospace (Fira Code or JetBrains Mono) for numerical data, badges, and status logs.
- Overall Vibe: Ultra-sleek, technical, developer-grade SaaS, clean and data-dense.

2. PAGE STRUCTURE (Top to Bottom):

- SECTION 1: HEADER / NAVBAR
  - Left: Minimalist logo and app name.
  - Center: Desktop nav links: "Features", "How it works", "Pricing".
  - Right: "Log in" (ghost button) and "Sign up" (accent filled CTA button).

- SECTION 2: HERO SECTION WITH INTERACTIVE SHELL
  - Top Pill: Small pill badge with status announcement (e.g., "Public Beta Live • Instant Access").
  - Headline (H1): Bold, benefit-driven headline focusing on generating structured execution plans from plain text prompts.
  - Subheadline: Explaining the transformation from natural language to complete automated output in seconds.
  - Hero Input Box: A prominent terminal/input box UI with a typing prompt placeholder, an action button ("Generate Plan"), and 3 quick-click sample prompt tags underneath.
  - Tech Integrations Bar: Muted, grayscale logos showing data/API provider integrations.

- SECTION 3: 3-STEP WORKFLOW CAROUSEL (Numbered 01, 02, 03)
  - Section Header: "From prompt to final execution in 3 steps".
  - Step 01: "Define Logic" -> Display UI visual of text prompt converting into structured rule fields.
  - Step 02: "Analyze Performance" -> Display UI visual of diagnostic metrics (win rate, drawdown, execution count).
  - Step 03: "Iterate & Refine" -> Display UI visual showing persistent context notes, draft management, and versioning panels.

- SECTION 4: BENTO FEATURE GRID
  - Showcase 4 distinct modular feature cards with dark UI mockups:
    1. Natural language logic generator.
    2. Real-time metric & diagnostic analytics board.
    3. Context-aware draft history & workspace.
    4. Structured parameters & validation setup.

- SECTION 5: LIVE SIMULATION / PROCESSING DRAWER
  - Interactive/animated timeline preview showing real-time background execution steps:
    - Step 1: Prompt Input.
    - Step 2: "Thinking" state showing a live status checklist (Reading -> Mapping -> Structuring -> Verifying).
    - Step 3: Generated Results Output (Displaying 6 metric stat blocks: Success Rate, Risk Score, Max Drawdown, Executions, Profit Factor, Expected Yield).

- SECTION 6: MID-PAGE BETA CTA BANNER
  - Contained dark card with accent glow border.
  - H2 callout offering immediate workspace access, complimentary starter usage credits, and saved draft features. Primary CTA: "Open Workspace".

- SECTION 7: PRICING MATRIX
  - Billing Toggle: "Pay Monthly" vs "Pay Yearly (Save 20%)".
  - 4 Tier Columns:
    - Tier 1 (Free - $0/mo): Starter access, limited execution credits, standard processing. CTA: "Get Started Free".
    - Tier 2 (Starter - $9/mo): Extended usage, basic alerts, entry tier caps.
    - Tier 3 (Pro - $29/mo - FEATURED "Best Value"): Marked with an accent border and highlight badge. High credit allowance, priority execution, deep diagnostics.
    - Tier 4 (Elite - $79/mo): Unlimited capabilities, max historical depth, multi-channel alerts.
  - Comprehensive feature comparison matrix beneath listing quota limits (Credits, Active Slots, Historical Bars, Alert Limits, Optimization runs).

- SECTION 8: FAQ ACCORDION
  - Accordion list answering essential conversion questions (Access immediacy, free tier capabilities, data handling, account requirements, update schedules).

- SECTION 9: FOOTER
  - Left column: Logo, support email, copyright.
  - Right columns: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Risk Disclaimer, Refund Policy, Acceptable Use, Cookie Settings.
  - Bottom row: Regulatory & technical attribution statements.

Make all components responsive, modern, and pixel-perfect with crisp typography, soft glowing drop shadows, and polished hover states.
